generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Fishing harbour at dawn (渔港清晨). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a working fishing harbour just after sunrise from the quay, using the portrait frame to layer water, vessel and harbour structures. Moor one inshore trawler across the middle, with its wheelhouse window unobstructed and a single quay crane rising into the upper third. In the foreground, isolate a bollard wrapped by one coil of rope, one insulated fish crate, a pair of upright deck boots, an orange net float and a landing net leaned safely against the crate. Fix the tide gauge vertically at the waterline. Add two distant crew members unloading nothing so hands do not obscure targets. Use misty golden light, wet stone and restrained reflections. No visible catch, brand names, vessel lettering, duplicate boats, piles of crates, tangled ropes or unsafe suspended loads.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: inshore fishing trawler, quayside harbour crane, coiled mooring rope, insulated fish crate, cast-iron harbour bollard, orange net float, long-handled landing net, waterproof deck boots, trawler wheelhouse window, harbour tide gauge.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
